form.label: Silent Sources
form.description: Currently monitored sources whose silence threshold has been exceeded, correlated with Splunk _internal heartbeat evidence when available.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_inventory | lookup local=true lsw_lastseen _key OUTPUT last_seen updated_at AS lastseen_updated_at | lookup local=true lsw_heartbeat host OUTPUT heartbeat_last_seen heartbeat_updated_at heartbeat_source heartbeat_type | `lsw_calculate_state` | where effective_state="SILENT" | eval haystack=lower(index." ".host) | where ($silent_index|s$="*" OR index=$silent_index|s$) | where len(trim($silent_text|s$))=0 OR like(haystack,"%".lower(trim($silent_text|s$))."%")

div.p: Sources that exceeded policy, with _internal correlation to distinguish source silence from a stale or missing Splunk heartbeat.

search.query: | inputlookup lsw_inventory | lookup local=true lsw_lastseen _key OUTPUT last_seen | lookup local=true lsw_heartbeat host OUTPUT heartbeat_last_seen heartbeat_source heartbeat_type | `lsw_calculate_state` | where effective_state="SILENT" | stats count BY index | sort 0 index
| stats count(eval(heartbeat_status="UNKNOWN" OR isnull(heartbeat_status))) AS value

| eval Threshold=round(threshold_seconds/60,0)." min", Silent_for=case(age_seconds<3600,round(age_seconds/60,1)." min",age_seconds<86400,round(age_seconds/3600,1)." h",true(),round(age_seconds/86400,1)." d"), Internal=case(heartbeat_status="ALIVE","ALIVE",heartbeat_status="STALE","STALE",true(),"NO EVIDENCE"), Internal_age=case(isnull(heartbeat_age_seconds),"—",heartbeat_age_seconds<3600,round(heartbeat_age_seconds/60,1)." min",heartbeat_age_seconds<86400,round(heartbeat_age_seconds/3600,1)." h",true(),round(heartbeat_age_seconds/86400,1)." d"), Diagnosis=coalesce(diagnosis_label,"Source silent · no _internal evidence") | sort 0 - age_seconds index host | rename index AS Index host AS Host | table Index Host Threshold Silent_for Internal Internal_age Diagnosis
